findings.reason: the column is nullable, so inserts succeed without it, but its value cannot be read back
findings.fix: add a field for note to domain.Event, or leave it unmapped on purpose and set strict.unmapped_columns: off

findings.message: public.events.happened is timestamp without time zone
findings.reason: the column stores a wall clock reading with no offset, so the instant it denotes depends on whoever reads it
findings.fix: change the column to timestamptz, or set strict.timestamp_without_tz: off if the ambiguity is intended
